title: Comfort Club Arrival Grace on Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
**Program bulletin.** Under Harbison's arrival guarantee on Repair and Emergency Service Calls, the arrival grace is the minutes added to the end of the booked arrival window before the technician's arrival counts as late. The grace follows the scheduling priority of the customer's active tier under Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements.

**Rule.** The arrival grace is 0 minutes for a customer whose active Comfort Club tier schedules front of line. It is 10 minutes for a customer whose active tier schedules with priority. It is the call class's 15 minutes for every other customer, including a member whose tier schedules at standard priority and any customer without an active agreement.

| Customer | Arrival grace |
|---|---|
| Active tier scheduling front of line | 0 minutes |
| Active tier scheduling with priority | 10 minutes |
| Everyone else | 15 minutes |

## Late from this moment (hypothetical windows)

| Booked window | Front of line: late after | Priority: late after | Everyone else: late after |
|---|---|---|---|
| 08:00-12:00 | 12:00 | 12:10 | 12:15 |
| 12:00-17:00 | 17:00 | 17:10 | 17:15 |
| 17:00-22:00 | 22:00 | 22:10 | 22:15 |

## Points of judgement

- A front-of-line member on a 12:00-17:00 window whose technician arrives at 17:05 is late. A priority member with the same arrival is not, because 17:05 is within 17:10.
- A member whose agreement is past due has no active tier and receives the 15-minute grace.
